plantillas.coverHelp: Design of the first page. Uses the same variables (school, course, head of department, role, date…) and the course logo via \logocentro. The LaTeX above must contain {{PORTADA}}; if empty, Lúa uses its own cover. Applies to PDF and .tex only.

plantillas.desfacer.ia.title: Go back to the state before the last AI change
plantillas.estiloHelp: The document design goes here, not in Lúa's code: paragraph and title formatting, the schedule labels (\chip, \mesbadge, trimestre environment), the minutes header (\actacab, \actasecc, \actasinaturas...). Empty, Lúa uses its own style; if you write something it replaces it entirely (start from Lúa's with the button below). Task colours (tf-*, tt-*, tb-*, tc-*), gris-linea, gris-texto, \fontchip and \logocentro always come from Lúa. It only applies to the PDF and the .tex.
plantillas.imagesHelp: They are stored with the template (not next to the course), so they work for any schedule wherever the file is. You can add several at once: images (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, TIFF…, and RAW, SVG or HEIC if a converter is installed) and PDFs, which do not lose quality. In LaTeX use the name as is, e.g. \includegraphics{logotipo.pdf}; in Word/ODT, @imaxe logotipo.pdf 10.
plantillas.intro: The template decides the report layout: header with the logo and the school name, footer with the phone numbers and the name of the counsellor, margins… The course stays the same. It applies to the preview and to everything you export: PDF, LaTeX, Markdown, Word and OpenDocument. Export a template and import it on another computer so the whole department uses the same style.
plantillas.introHelp: Text of the “Introduction” section. You can use variables such as {{CENTRO}}, {{CURSO}} and {{DEPARTAMENTO}}; a blank line separates paragraphs. If the course has its own introduction, that one wins. Empty = Lúa's text.
plantillas.latexHelp: Write {{CORPO}} wherever you want the report to go (index, introduction, schedule and development). If you do not add \documentclass, Lúa adds its own preamble (enough for header and footer; it already loads fancyhdr); if you do, you are in charge and Lúa only adds the packages and definitions the report needs. The first and last pages are designed below and go wherever you put {{PORTADA}} and {{SINATURA}}; without those markers Lúa uses its own cover and signature. Put the school's fixed data as variables: {{TELEFONO}}, {{CORREO}}… Lúa fills them in on its own, from the course and the school: {{CENTRO}}, {{LOCALIDADE}}, {{CURSO}}, {{DEPARTAMENTO}}, {{XEFE}} (or {{ORIENTADOR}}), {{CARGO}}, {{TITULO}}, {{DATA}}, {{DATA_LONGA}}, {{DATA_INICIO}}, {{DATA_FIN}}, {{ANO}} and {{FICHEIRO}}; if a variable with the same name has a value in the template, that value wins. The course logo is set with \logocentro[height=2cm].
plantillas.markdownHelp: Same {{CORPO}} and same variables, but in Markdown. If you leave it empty, the .md comes out without a layout. Images are referenced here as images/logo.png.
plantillas.name: Name
plantillas.needBody: {{CORPO}} is missing: without it Lúa does not know where to put the report.
plantillas.noVars: No variables. Add one so a fixed value (the phone number, the school email…) can be changed without touching the LaTeX.
plantillas.noneDesc: The report comes out with Lúa's default layout.
plantillas.ofi.axuda: Lúa generates the document’s information; the look in Word and OpenDocument (font, colours, cover, header and footer) belongs to the template. Anything left empty uses Lúa’s default design. You can use the same variables ({{CENTRO}}, {{CURSO}}…).
plantillas.ofi.cabeceira: Header (on every page except the cover)
plantillas.ofi.caixaAxuda: The header and footer can hold several logos in a row: one line per element, like “@imaxe logo1.png 10”, “@imaxe logo2.pdf 10” (height in mm; PNG, JPEG or PDF from this template’s image folder), text with variables, and “@esquerda”, “@centro” or “@dereita”.
plantillas.ofi.marxesAxuda: Leave line spacing and margins empty to use Lúa's defaults (1.15 and 2.5 cm in Word; 2 cm in OpenDocument).
plantillas.ofi.pe: Footer text (next to the page number)
plantillas.ofi.portadaAxuda: One line per element: @logo 35 (course logo, height in mm), @imaxe nome.png 30 (an image of this template), @espazo 12, # Title, ## Subtitle, --- (rule), ### Highlighted line and plain text. Empty = the default cover.
plantillas.pdfVectorial: Vector: it does not lose quality in the report PDF. In Word/OpenDocument a pixel image of its page 1 is used.
plantillas.previewNoPages: It compiled, but the preview could not be drawn (pdftoppm is missing).
plantillas.save.title: Save the template and close the editor (Ctrl+Enter)
plantillas.savingFirst: Saving the template before adding the image…

plantillas.signatureHelp: Design of the document's closing block (date, who signs and role). It goes at the end, without its own page; if you want one, start the fragment with \clearpage. The LaTeX above must contain {{SINATURA}}; if empty, Lúa uses its own signature block. Applies to PDF and .tex only.
plantillas.textosHelp: Lúa generates the content; the fixed texts of the document (section titles, "No tasks", the minutes labels...) are changed here, in PDF, Word, OpenDocument and Markdown. Empty = Lúa's text (the grey one). The variables {{CENTRO}}, {{CURSO}}, {{DEPARTAMENTO}}... and those listed for each text can be used.

formularios.flx.intro.texto: Each field appears in the document according to its type: sections are headings, simple values go in a data sheet, and long texts and tables get their own heading. That is enough for most forms.
formularios.flx.intro.texto2: Customise the pipelines if you want to calculate something (averages, weighted marks, percentages), filter or sort a table, build sentences, show a block only in some cases or change the document order.
formularios.dis.asistente.label: Design assistant
formularios.asistente.label: Data assistant
asistente.tf.benvida: I design forms and pipelines. Attach with the clip a document you already have (a report, minutes, a mark sheet…) and I will work out the fields, tables and calculations from it; or describe what you need. Changes go into the designer draft and you decide whether to save them.
asistente.tf.nota: You can undo the last change with the “Undo AI change” button. If the document has calculations, check them carefully: always test what the assistant gives you.
asistente.tf.ph: Describe the form you want, or ask for changes: “add a students table”, “calculate the average mark”… If you press a card, this is added as an extra instruction.
asistente.tf.crear: Create a form from a description
formularios.nodo.constante.axuda: A text or number you type (e.g. a weight 0.4 or a pass mark 5).
formularios.nodo.calcular.axuda: Does a calculation with the incoming numbers (a, b, c...). Operators + - * / % ^ and comparisons; functions min, max, abs, sqrt, round(x,n), suma, media, se(cond,a,b). Decimal point: 0.4.
formularios.nodo.agregar.axuda: Gets a number from a table: sum, average, minimum, maximum or how many rows there are.
formularios.nodo.filtrar.axuda: Keeps only the table rows that meet a condition.
formularios.nodo.ordenar.axuda: Sorts the table rows by a column.
formularios.nodo.columnas.axuda: Keeps only some table columns (in the order you choose).
formularios.nodo.unir.axuda: Builds a sentence from the incoming values: in the template write {{a}}, {{b}}... where each goes.
formularios.nodo.comparar.axuda: Gives yes or no by comparing two values. Useful to hide a block (the “if” input of the blocks).
formularios.nodo.titulo.axuda: A heading in the document. Type fixed text or connect a text.
formularios.nodo.paragrafo.axuda: A Markdown text. It does not appear if empty.
formularios.nodo.ficha.axuda: “label: value” pairs one under another. Empty values are skipped.
formularios.nodo.taboa.axuda: Shows a table. It does not appear if it has no rows.
formularios.nodo.lista.axuda: A bulleted list with the values of a table column.
formularios.nodo.grafico.axuda: A chart. Pick the type (pie, donut, bars, lines...) and give it data: either a table (category column + value columns) or several loose quantities, each with its own label. It does not appear if there is no data.
formularios.cfg.grafico.columna.axuda: Only if you connect a table.
formularios.cfg.grafico.columnas.axuda: Each column is a series. Pie and donut use only the first.
formularios.nodo.imaxe.axuda: Shows an image. It does not appear if there is none.

You can attach documents with a paperclip (a syllabus, a past exam…) for me to take into account, useful for designing exams and practice exercises. I can only see this form, its data and the documents you attach, and only while it is in design mode.

options.maxima.decimais: Decimal places in results (0 = Maxima's own)
options.maxima.hint: Maxima computes the formulas in problems (as in Yang) and checks the AI's solutions. Without Maxima, Lúa only computes numbers and simple formulas.
problemas.axuda: Formulas with $…$ (inline) or $$…$$ (centred). A variable goes in braces: {m}. Inside a formula, $\dfrac{m}{V}$ are the letters and $\dfrac{ {m} }{ {V} }$ the values.
problemas.calculos.axuda: Values used by the statement, in Maxima: P = expand((x-r1)*(x-r2)) and in the statement $ {P} = 0 $.
problemas.comprobacions.axuda: One condition per line that must always hold (Maxima): F > 0
problemas.enCola: Queued: solved after the previous ones…
problemas.enunciado.ph: E.g.: A {m} kg body accelerates at {a} m/s². Calculate the force: $F = m\,a$.
problemas.instrucions.ph: Instructions for the AI (optional): “solve using energy”…
problemas.maxima.instalando: Installing Maxima… (may ask for your password and take a few minutes)
problemas.maxima.non: No Maxima: only numbers and simple formulas
problemas.maxima.ok.title: Calculations are done with Maxima, as in Yang
problemas.numerosVariables.title: Turns the numbers in the statement's formulas into variables (fixed, with the same value). Then you can make any of them variable.
problemas.resolvendo.maxima: The AI is solving and Maxima is checking…
problemas.resolverCampo.title: Solves the questions in this field that do not have a solution yet
problemas.resolverExame.title: Solves at once all the questions in the form that do not have a solution yet
problemas.semIA: Set up an AI provider in Options to solve with AI
problemas.sol.baleira: No solution. It is only filled in when you ask for it.
problemas.sol.calculos.axuda: Each calculation gives a value you can use as {nome}: F = m*a. With Maxima anything goes (solve, diff, factor...).
problemas.sol.nonparam: The AI could not make it parametric: it only works for these values.
problemas.sol.texto.ph: Step by step, with {variables} and $formulas$: $F = m\,a = {F}$ N
problemas.sol.vella: This solution is not parametric and was solved with other values: solve it again or make the variables fixed.
problemas.sol.vista.baleira: Write the working: you will see how it looks here.
problemas.var.agora.title: The value with this seed
problemas.var.fixa.title: Always the same value
problemas.var.quitar: The statement no longer uses {v}: remove it
problemas.var.variable.title: A random value from the range for each seed (one per copy of the exam)
problemas.vars.ningunha: No variables. Write {nome} in the statement (or use “Numbers → variables”) and you will be able to make them fixed or variable.
problemas.vista.baleira: You will see the question here with its formulas and values.
toolbar.iterations.label: Iterations
toolbar.iterations.title: Copies of the document: each one has a different seed (seed, seed+1...), so each student gets their own numbers. Solutions included.
toolbar.seed.label: Seed
toolbar.seed.title: Seed: the same number always gives the same variable values. Changing it gives another exam with the same statement.
toolbar.solutions.label: Solutions
toolbar.solutions.title: Which solutions appear in the document

toolbar.trasladar.label: Transfer
toolbar.trasladar.title: Transfer: take something out of Lúa (a project, a document or a backup of everything) or bring a file in (Ctrl+Shift+S / Ctrl+O). Lúa saves everything on its own.
trasladar.cursos: This file contains {n} courses. Each one you choose goes into its own project:
trasladar.desfeito: Undone: everything is as it was.
trasladar.destino.aberto: It goes into the open project, «{nome}».
trasladar.destino.biblioteca: It goes into the library. Nothing you already have is changed.
trasladar.destino.boveda: It goes into the vault of the open project, «{nome}». Repeated names come in as copies.
trasladar.destino.novo: Lúa creates a new project for it. Nothing you already have is changed.
trasladar.destino.restaurar: Restores ALL of Lúa as it was in the backup. The current state is saved first and you can undo.
trasladar.destino.volta: Updates «{doc}» in the project «{nome}». The previous version is saved and you can undo.

trasladar.metido: Done. It is now in Lúa.

trasladar.nada: You have not chosen anything to take out.
trasladar.op.documento: This document, «{nome}», to edit it elsewhere · .json file
